column1: # The pronouns, one per line: word<TAB>roles (comma-separated).
# reader   a pronoun the reader keeps as a filler word and never reads as a verb,
#          in the nominative as the IR does (`her` stays `her`).
# subject  can open a clause as its subject (also what `a <pronoun>` ahead of a
#          sentence marks as an item label, not a sentence).
# object   reads as a recipient at the head of a ditransitive command.
# third_singular  he/she/it: the present verb takes -s.
# first_person     I/we: the present copula is am/are.
# s_host   takes `'s` as is/has (`he's`), never as a possessive.
